name: SnappShop Sellers for WooCommerce
author: SnappShop

sections.description:
SnappShop Sellers for WooCommerce helps sellers connect their WooCommerce store to SnappShop Seller Center. After installing the plugin, copy the connection address and access token from its settings into Seller Center.

SnappShop can then read your published product catalog, including product details, prices, stock, images, categories, and attributes. The plugin does not change your WooCommerce catalog. Product publishing and order management are not included in this version.

You need an active WooCommerce installation and a SnappShop Seller Center account. Visit https://seller.snappshop.ir/ to learn about Seller Center.

Features:

  • Make your published WooCommerce catalog available to SnappShop.
  • Share product details, prices, stock, images, categories, and attributes.
  • Copy your connection address from the plugin settings.
  • Protect the connection with an access token, enabled by default.
  • Manage the connection and access token from a Persian settings page.

Service and privacy

The plugin does not contact SnappShop servers on its own. When you enter your connection address and access token in SnappShop Seller Center, that service can request published catalog data from your store. Customer and order data are not shared by this plugin.

If you turn off token protection, anyone with the connection address can request the published catalog data while the connection is enabled. Turning off the connection in the plugin settings stops catalog access through the plugin. Use HTTPS for your store and keep your access token private.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active on your WordPress site.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for “SnappShop Sellers for WooCommerce” and select the plugin by SnappShop Company.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Open SnappShop > Sellers (اسنپ شاپ > فروشندگان), or click Settings (تنظیمات) beside the plugin on the Plugins page.
  6. Keep the connection enabled and token protection turned on. You can leave Base URI at its default value.
  7. Copy the displayed connection address and access token into your SnappShop Seller Center connection settings.

You can also find the plugin at https://wordpress.org/plugins/snappshop-sellers/.
sections.faq:
What do I need before connecting my store?

You need WordPress, an active WooCommerce installation, and a SnappShop Seller Center account. Install the plugin from the WordPress.org directory through your WordPress dashboard, then follow the connection steps above.

Where do I find the connection address and access token?

Open اسنپ شاپ > فروشندگان in your WordPress dashboard. The settings page displays your connection address with a copy button and provides access token controls.

Does this plugin publish products or manage orders in SnappShop?

No. This version lets SnappShop read your published WooCommerce catalog. Product publishing and order management are not included.

Do I need to change Base URI?

No. Leave the default value unless you need to change your connection address. If you change it, save the settings and copy the new address into Seller Center.

What happens if I generate a new access token?

The previous token stops working while token protection is enabled. Copy the replacement token into Seller Center to keep the connection working.

What happens if token protection is disabled?

Published catalog data can be requested without a token while the connection is enabled. The saved token is retained and becomes required again when you re-enable protection.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is required. The catalog connection is unavailable when WooCommerce is inactive.

How do I update the plugin?

Go to Dashboard > Updates or Plugins > Installed Plugins and use the available WordPress.org update for SnappShop Sellers for WooCommerce.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Add a public status response at /wp-json/snappshop-seller/status.

1.0.2

  • Include variation attributes in catalog access and remove duplicate attribute names, keeping the entry with the largest ID.
  • Include all assigned category names in product details.

1.0.1

  • Clarify installation from WordPress.org and the steps to connect a store to Seller Center.
  • Simplify seller documentation to focus on setup and connection settings.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with published product catalog access for SnappShop Seller Center.
  • Persian settings page with a configurable connection address and optional access token protection.
